lines.text: One small change with Antigravity and Gemini.
lines.spoken: Run one small change with Antigravity and Gemini in Spec With Code. This walkthrough prepares the task; it does not submit a provider run.

lines.text: In Settings, Providers, enable Antigravity on the project’s machine, install its runtime and complete its separate sign-in. Wait for account access and the model list. Choose a Gemini model that account actually offers.
lines.spoken: In Settings, Providers, enable Antigravity on the project’s machine, install its runtime and complete its separate sign-in. Wait for account access and the model list. Choose a Gemini model that account actually offers.

lines.text: Open an example repository as a project. Keep the execution machine visible.
lines.spoken: Open an example repository as a project. The main conversation is the project coordinator. Check which machine is doing the work.

lines.text: Select your provider, available model and approval mode.
lines.spoken: Select Antigravity, then an available Gemini model and the approval mode you intend to use. This tutorial does not require full access.

lines.text: Add greet(name), keep greet() working, and run the tests.
lines.spoken: Give it one bounded task: add a named greeting, keep the no argument greeting working, and add tests for both. Ask it to describe the change before editing. Antigravity has its own native plan command; do not assume the app’s separate Plan mode is available.

lines.text: Review the plan. Approve only the intended commands.
lines.spoken: Read the proposed change, then ask it to implement. Review any command approval rather than accepting it automatically.

lines.text: Read the diff and test output. Keep failures visible.
lines.spoken: Inspect the changed files and the actual test output. If a check failed or was not run, keep that in the result. A confident reply is not test evidence.
Finish with the change, its diff, and actual test evidence. Use Spec Weave increments when you need a durable plan and task record. They are optional for this first task.
